components.name: 产品识别标题
components.purpose: 说明产品类别，或保留既有选款标题作为对照
components.requires: product-name uses a confirmed product_name fact; baseline only reuses the locked project's existing headline

components.name: 选款事实条
components.purpose: 保留原副标题或精简为已核实款数与尺寸数量
components.requires: design_count and sizes_inches must match the product matrix; no inferred performance claims

components.name: 款式定位标签
components.purpose: 沿用构图中各款的标签位置，准确关联实际款式
components.position_source: locked composition slots; never shift products to fit a label

components.name: 尺寸规格条
components.purpose: 按已确认记录显示全部尺寸及in单位，不给床型或年龄适用保证
components.requires: confirmed sizes_inches; optional, omit if it crowds the product or repeats another module
